question: In which state of India is the Iravatanesvara temple situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Iravatanesvara Temple **is located in the state of **Tamil Nadu.**
 
• Specifically, **the temple is situated in the town of Kumbakonam.**
 
• **Kumbakonam **is in the **Thanjavur district of Tamil Nadu.**
 
• The temple is **dedicated to Lord Shiva.**
 
• **It is a popular pilgrimage site for devotees of Hinduism.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Important Temples of different states:**__
 
• **Tamil Nadu:**
 
 
• **Meenakshi Amman Temple **in **Madurai**.
 
• **Brihadeeswarar Temple** in **Thanjavur**.
 
• **Rameshwaram Temple** in **Rameshwaram**.
 
• **Sri Ranganathaswamy Temple** in **Srirangam**.
 
• **Kanchipuram Kamakshi Amman Temple** in **Kanchipuram**.
 
 
 
• **West Bengal:**
 
 
• **Dakshineswar Kali Temple** in **Kolkata**.
 
• **Kalighat Kali Temple** in **Kolkata**.
 
• **Tarapith Temple** in **Birbhum**.
 
• **Jangipur Hanuman Temple **in **Jangipur**.
 
 
 
• **Rajasthan:**
 
 
• **Dilwara Jain Temples** in **Mount Abu.**
 
• **Jagdish Temple** in **Udaipur.**
 
• **Karni Mata Temple** in **Bikaner**.
 
• **Govind Devji Temple** in **Jaipur**.
 
• **Shri Eklingji Temple **in **Udaipur**.
 
 
 
• **Telangana:**
 
 
• **Birla Mandir** in **Hyderabad**.
 
• **Bhadrakali Temple** in **Warangal**.
 
• **Kaleshwara Mukteswara Swamy Temple** in **Kaleshwaram**.
 
• **Chilkur Balaji Temple** in **Hyderabad**.
 
• **Yadagirigutta Temple** in **Yadagirigutta**.
